# Rendered Branch Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Move generated `rendered/` from `main` to an orphan `rendered` branch written only by CI; CODEOWNERS regenerated by PR authors and verified by CI; no bot commits on `main`.

**Architecture:** CI renders on push to `main` and commits to `rendered`; all Argo CD AppSets and the Kargo Warehouse read `rendered`. PR CI comments the diff vs `origin/rendered` and checks CODEOWNERS.

**Tech Stack:** GitHub Actions, CUE, bash, yq, Argo CD ApplicationSets, Kargo 1.12.5.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-10-rendered-branch-design.md`

## Global Constraints

- jj only locally; `jj commit -m` with `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`.
- Branch name `rendered`; path inside it `rendered/` (unchanged).
- Bot commit message `render: <sha7>` + body `source: <commit URL>`.
- CI push uses `GITHUB_TOKEN` (`contents: write`); no new secrets.

## Review Focus

1. Bootstrap order: AppSets referencing a not-yet-existing `rendered` branch must retry, not wedge (check `retry.limit: -1` / ApplicationSet requeue). Pinned by: Task 2 check.sh rule + post-merge `mise run up`.
2. PR comment when `origin/rendered` doesn't exist yet (first PR): must not fail CI. Pinned by: Task 3 step.
3. A PR that edits `rendered/` on `main`: rejected. Pinned by: Task 3 guard.
4. Deleted system: full render on `rendered` must drop it (render task wipes generated dirs). Existing test covers render task wipe.
5. Kargo `git-clone` of a Freight commit only reachable from `rendered`: must work. Pinned by: post-merge manual promotion.

### Task 1: Warehouse + `mise run codeowners`

**Files:** `platform/render/input.cue` (add `renderedBranch: "rendered"`), `platform/render/delivery.cue:95`, `platform/mise-tasks/codeowners` (new), `platform/render/scripts/test.sh`, golden.

- [ ] Assert in test.sh: `yq 'select(.kind=="Warehouse") | .spec.subscriptions[0].git.branch' "$k" | sort -u` == `rendered`. Run → FAIL.
- [ ] `branch: renderedBranch`. `UPDATE=1` golden after reviewing diff (only `branch:` lines). Run → PASS.
- [ ] `codeowners` task: temp out dir, `render.sh . <sys> $tmp` for each system, `codeowners.sh . $tmp`. Verify: `mise run codeowners && jj diff .github/CODEOWNERS` → empty.
- [ ] Commit `render: Warehouse reads the rendered branch; mise run codeowners`.

### Task 2: AppSets read `rendered`

**Files:** `platform/appsets/{kargo,projects,workloads}.yaml`, `platform/appsets/addons/{kargo-shard-hub,argocd-region-hub}.yaml`, `platform/appsets/check.sh`.

- [ ] check.sh rule: for each AppSet, every git generator (`.spec.generators[]..git`) or source whose `path`/`files[].path` starts with `rendered/` has revision/targetRevision `rendered`; any other with `rendered` fails. Run `platform/appsets/check.sh` → FAIL.
- [ ] Switch the five revisions. Run → PASS; `mise run test` → PASS.
- [ ] Commit `appsets: read rendered/ from the rendered branch`.

### Task 3: CI + remove `rendered/` from main

**Files:** `.github/workflows/ci.yaml`, `.gitignore`, delete `rendered/`, `platform/mise-tasks/render` comment.

- [ ] ci.yaml:
  - drop `paths-ignore`; concurrency `cancel-in-progress` only for PRs (unchanged).
  - PR guard: fail if PR changes `rendered/` (`::error::rendered/ lives on the rendered branch`); fail if `mise run codeowners` leaves a diff on `.github/CODEOWNERS` (`::error file=.github/CODEOWNERS::stale; run mise run codeowners`).
  - render: `mise run render` (writes ignored `rendered/`).
  - diff: `git fetch origin rendered` (tolerate missing) → worktree `$RUNNER_TEMP/rb` of `origin/rendered` (or empty orphan) → `rsync -a --delete rendered/ $RUNNER_TEMP/rb/rendered/` → `git -C rb add -A` → diff/comment from there.
  - push to main: in the worktree, commit `render: ${GITHUB_SHA::7}` (body `source: <url>`) if staged changes, `git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/rendered`.
- [ ] `.gitignore` `/rendered/`; `jj file untrack`-equivalent: delete `rendered/` from `main` (`rm -rf rendered`). `mise run render` then `jj st` → no `rendered/` entries.
- [ ] `actionlint` clean (`mise x actionlint@1.7.7 -- actionlint .github/workflows/ci.yaml`); `mise run test` → PASS.
- [ ] Commit `ci: render to the rendered branch, not main`.

- [ ] Protect `rendered`: `gh api -X PUT repos/pitoniak32/gitops-cd/branches/rendered/protection` with `restrictions` empty except Actions (or `lock_branch` false, `allow_force_pushes` false, `enforce_admins` false; push restricted to `github-actions` app).
